title: UI UX Design Fundamentals
shortDescription: Learn user-centered design basics, wireframes, visual hierarchy, and usability thinking.
description: Learn user-centered design basics, wireframes, visual hierarchy, and usability thinking. This course is designed for Cameroonian university students, graduates, independent learners, tutors, and small training organisations. It uses concise text lessons and external resources so learners can study on mobile devices and unstable networks without relying on hosted video.
